Title: I got H0040 “Communication error between local and remote Sentinel HASP License Managers” error.
Content: The error occurs when the Server PC and the Client PC could not communicate with each other. To solve the problem, Enter services.msc in the execution window. Check if Sentinel Local License Manager is getting started in the service window. If the status is not getting started, click your right mouse button and choose Start then restart your computer. If you still have the problem, check if the version of the HASP driver in the Server PC and the Client PC is the same. If they are different, make their version the same. You can get the version information from the image below. If any of the above methods do not work, ask a network expert for help on how to communicate the status between ports such as Server and Client Check if 1947 port is occupied by other services or not.

Title: I have a verification issue. What should I do?
Content: Objective This FAQ will cover the trouble shooting for a verification issue. Details Please use Chrome instead of other internet browsers. Marvelous Designer, and CLO-SET website is optimized as Chrome. [CASE 1]If you didn't receive the verification email, please check your spam mailbox. Sometimes the verification email can be found in your spam folder, or you will need to refresh your browser. [CASE 2]If Marvelous Designer web requires verification, even if you already verify it, please remove your old cookie and cache. In Chrome On your computer, open Chrome. At the top right, click More. Click "Clear Browsing History". Select a period on the top. To delete everything, select All time. Activate the checkboxes next to "Cookies and other site data" and "Cached images and files". Click Clear data. [CASE 3]Some school domains block external emails. If so, you can check your school domain is connected to the verification email on Verify Email Address Link. If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from Marvelous Designer. If you still have not received your verification email, please reach out to Marvelous Designer via Contact Us.

Title: Shirring and Crease Principle
Content: Shirring principle In this course, we will explore the different types of shirring shapes based on fabric. In addition to the wrinkles generated by the default fabric, there are various types of wrinkles, such as narrow wrinkles and wide wrinkles. You can achieve the desired wrinkles by adjusting the Detail items in the Fabric Property, but it may be challenging for beginners. However, if you understand the differences in how each fabric forms wrinkles, you can easily create various styles of wrinkles. Crease principle In this course, we will learn about the shape of creases based on fabric. When fabrics are stretched or overlapped with each other, various creases are formed based on the type of fabric. Following the Shirring principle, you can refer to the creases made for each fabric and apply them to the clothes you plan to create in the future.
